The service rejected this. INC4900001 is already the reference of a notice in tenant ux4-none-free (the ServiceNow incident number doubles as the reference). References are permanent, even after a notice is retired, so a follow-up for the same incident needs another External reference (INC4900001-2 to INC4900001-51 are taken as well).
